COMMUNICATION
.1-6: Shortcut for using channels F1-F6. .AFK: Toggles "Away From Keyboard" status. Places parentheses around your name while AFK. .FRIENDS: Lists all players on your Friends list .FRIEND (PLAYER): Adds or removes a player from your Friends list .IGNORE (PLAYER): Adds or removes player from your Ignore list. You will not received messages from ignored players. (Also .IG). .M (PLAYER) (TEXT): Sends a Private Message to a specified player .NOECHAT: Toggle receipt of enemy area chat on/off. .R (TEXT): Replies to the sender of the last Private Message recieved .WHISPER (TEXT): Sends text on local channel, but only for short distance. (also .WHI, .W). .YELL (TEXT): Send text on local channel for greater ditances. (Also .YE, .Y).
ACTION COMMANDS
CTRL+1: You yell "Double Time!" CTRL+2: You yell "Take cover!" CTRL+3: You yell "Stop!" CTRL+4: You yell "Move Out!" CTRL+5: You yells "More Ammo!"
EMOTES
.EM SALUTE: Your personna will come to attention and salute .EM CHEER: You start celebrating something .EM DOUBLE: You yell "Double Time". .EM GYRUS: You surrender. .EM LAUGH: You laugh. .EM JUMP: You shout JUMP, JUMP, JUMP!!!
